evidence.claim: Route UI shows duration/outcome odds/reasons but does not render returned costs.

findings.proposed_player_behavior: One compact action card shows Spend, Use/keep, time on the applicable clock, known result/risk, affected participant and cancellation terms. A blocked card shows known declared terms plus the blocker, with no executable quote or invented free cost.

findings.proposed_player_behavior: Show current unit, completed/remaining target, next-start known inputs, pause-after-current status and the actual next-start blocker. Reuse legal prepared routines for optional production/training; keep meaningful choices/manual interventions visible and show functional progress at useful milestones.
